run_TREC_Finegrained_main: run the TREC fine-grained dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_TREC_Finegrained_class: create a TREC_Finegrained classification dataset instance with 47 fine-grained label categories for question classification
review_get_train_test_lines: review the get_train_test_lines method that splits the training set into 80 percent train and 20 percent test
summarize_map_hf_dataset_to_list: summarize the map_hf_dataset_to_list method that converts a HuggingFace dataset split into text label tuples
test_load_dataset: test the load_dataset method that loads the TREC dataset from the HuggingFace datasets library
